name: Dufu Technology Corp. Berhad
summary: Dufu Technology Corp. Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial products. The company designs, develops, manufactures, assembles, and trades in die components and precision machining of vice, computer peripherals, and parts for hard disk drives. It also manufactures and trades in optics, magnetism drivers, and parts; and processes and trades in computer disk-drive-related components.
